x: Gilt edge Hart, Duquemin, Middleton, Major, Kerr and Martin continue as the backbone of our economy. Whilst high flyers Bent and Thresher continue to excite, Dull spots occurred with results from Hilton, C.
In the team event there were several strong teams out but defending champions Belgrave were so strong that despite losing Duquemin, Keown and Picton we were still able to win by 11 points.

Despite the absence of Duquemin and Callow, Bels easily won this meeting for the second consecutive year. It was made easy for us by the fact that none of the other teams could round up a full compliment.

Our last win was in the Belgrave Open when our Commonwealth Games representatives of Lawton, Callow, Duquemin and Moullin were victorious. Our 'B' team was then left to represent us at the subsequent Bexley and Imber Court races.
